# A folder deleted around a parked node after a rewind: the tests check that the folder is created again (once, outermost first, after a scan or a recovery answer) and that an ordinary remote delete is not undone. A parked node whose folder never reached the server stays parked with what it holds, sends nothing, keeps its tree across two settles, and is reported as a problem in the engine and in the driver status. The generated check (parked_nodes_and_rules) builds trees up to three deep with parked nodes, removes or replaces folders, and adds rules before or after, with or without a restart. It asserts three things: nothing excluded is sent, nothing under a folder deleted before it reached the server is sent, and every node in reach is sent once the builds settle. No existing test covers a parked node whose folder was deleted, so none of these could be reused.
